patterns.name: Upstream Diagnosis Over Symptom Patching
patterns.principle: Trace every operational failure upstream to its boundary handoff or contract failure instead of treating downstream symptoms.

patterns.name: Technical Rigor Over Marketing Hype
patterns.principle: Never use buzzwords ('disruptive', 'revolutionary', 'game-changing'); explain the physical or economic mechanism with precision.

patterns.name: Evidence Ladder Verification
patterns.principle: Every claim must declare its evidence tier (in-silico, benchmark, in-vitro, verified telemetry, human trial). Never equate simulation with physical reality.

patterns.name: Unresolved Complexity Acknowledgment
patterns.principle: Acknowledge edge cases and boundary conditions where the framework does not apply. Demonstrating limitations increases authority.

patterns.name: Tool-Agnostic First Principles
patterns.principle: Focus on data contracts, algorithmic invariants, and system architecture rather than endorsing specific software vendors.

patterns.name: Scientific Rigor vs Commercial Governance Balance
patterns.principle: Strictly partition wetlab empirical proof (Facu) from commercial capitalization and IP governance (Rafa). Never blur laboratory findings into unverified sales claims.

patterns.name: Conversational Boundary Stress Testing
patterns.principle: Use multi-speaker interview collision to stress-test software architecture assertions against edge cases live on camera.

patterns.name: Capital Expenditure & Regulatory Prequalification
patterns.principle: Filter all energy and infrastructure initiatives through interconnection delay and tariff exposure before analyzing equipment efficiency.
